_note: Board 303:1997 — the Media drawer while the image editor is open. The
state is unreachable by clicking: `handleEditImage` sets the pill and
then hands off to `onOpenImageEditor`, whose modal lives in
AquibraStudio, so the drawer is inert behind it. The probe mounts the
real SlimLauncher with the pill prop the real handler sets.
The pill IS the board. 333:2340 sits at left 15 / top 63 — over the
search box — which is where a floating status goes and nowhere a
laid-out control could be; the code already reads these two boards that
way and owns both strings verbatim.
WHAT MOVED: the pill was a bare `--bk-bg-subtle` tint with no rule and ink
text at 12/18. The board draws the chrome-ui Badge — gray-200 fill, a
gray-400 rule, 10/2 padding, 12/16 Medium gray-700 — which is what makes it
read as something laid OVER the grid rather than as a row inside it. The
raised shadow stays; a 0/1/2 shadow is not a thing a board can draw and it
is what keeps the pill legible over a card.
NOT ANCHORED, and why: the board's asset CARDS (`Card / media`, four of
them at 104 tall with 76 thumbs and two `badge` children). They are the
same component `media-drawer` already measures against 144:29.., this
board's copy of them is unchanged from that frame, and the fixture here
renders a different number of them. The two boards' whole subject is the
pill; everything else is the base drawer, measured on its own board.
The badge width (186 on 333:2340, intrinsic on 333:2342) is the label's own
text width in Figma and is not a design constraint.
TWO TARGETS DROPPED FROM BOTH BOARDS, both because a better board already
owns them:
· `footer`. 303:2026 / 303:2061 draw a 44-tall bar carrying two accent
text links (`↑ Upload`, `☁ Stock`). The shipped foot is the UploadZone
plus the storage bar and measures 182. That is not this board's subject
and the base drawer board 144:46 — which `media-drawer` already
conforms — draws the real one. Two boards disagreeing about the drawer
foot is settled on the board boards.json already verified against.
· the badge BOX on this board only. 333:2340 declares `w-[186px]` around a
`whitespace-nowrap` 12px label 36 characters long, which measures 227 in
a browser — the Figma frame clips its own text. Every other property of
that badge (fill, rule, padding, radius) is identical on 333:2342, which
hugs its label, and IS measured on the optimizing recipe. So the box is
skipped here and measured there rather than conformed to a clipped
frame.
